meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals. Use Computer Use for external browser windows, webviews, Orca app UI, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser only when the task requires OS/window-level control such as focus, menus, dialogs, coordinates, or screenshots. Use `orca-cli` for Orca's embedded pages and a page-automation tool such as Playwright or CDP for external pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统筹多个 AI 工人,分步交接并监督任务执行进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把复杂任务拆给多个 AI 工人,并保持过程可控可见。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate several AI workers to split tasks and oversee step-by-step progress.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage several AI assistants and want visible, controlled delegation across them.

howto.what: Claude 会在 Orca 运行时里协调多个受监督的 worker:收发线程消息、阻塞式 ask/reply、派发任务、等待 worker_done 或升级,并按任务 DAG 推进、设决策门,把工作拆给多个 agent。
howto.when: 当任务需要结构化多 agent 协调(线程消息、阻塞式 ask/reply、任务 DAG 等)时接管;若你只是要「hand off」式的完全交接,则改用 orca-cli 技能。

say.text: 用 Orca 起一个协调循环,把这三个任务分派给 worker。
say.note: Claude 会建立协调循环并分派任务。

say.text: 派发这个任务后阻塞等待 worker_done,有升级就告诉我。
say.note: Claude 会阻塞等待该 worker 的结果。

say.text: 把这项工作拆成任务 DAG,加一个决策门再往下走。
say.note: Claude 会按 DAG 推进并停在决策门。

howto.what_en: Claude coordinates supervised Orca workers from the Orca runtime: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, waiting on worker_done or escalation, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and splitting work across agents.
howto.when_en: Takes over when a task needs structured multi-agent coordination — threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task DAGs and similar. For full-ownership handoffs like "hand off", use orca-cli.

say_en.text: Start an Orca coordinator loop and dispatch these three tasks to workers.
say_en.note: Claude sets up the loop and assigns the tasks.

say_en.text: Dispatch the task, block until worker_done, and tell me about any escalation.
say_en.note: Claude waits on the worker instead of moving on.

say_en.text: Split this work into a task DAG and add a decision gate before continuing.
say_en.note: Claude models the work as a DAG with a gate.
